summary: The registrant, ExchangeRight Income Fund, filed a Form 8-K under Item 8.01 reporting routine updates to its continuous private placement offering, monthly dividend declaration, and DRIP reinvestment activity. No special-situation event occurred. The filing disclosed share issuance data across multiple share classes, a $0.1449 per share dividend declared July 31, 2026, and 10% dividend reinvestment election. These are ordinary operational disclosures for a continuously-offering REIT, lacking any M&A, restructuring, or strategic transaction. The filing contains no terms indicative of an acquisition, divestiture, tender, or going-private transaction. It is a routine current report with no special-situation implications.
